the_sun.name: The Sun (Central Star)
the_sun.description: Main-sequence star at the centre of the Solar System whose immense gravitational pull holds all planets, moons, and asteroids in elliptical orbits and provides radiant energy.

mercury.name: Mercury (1st Rocky Planet)
mercury.description: Smallest terrestrial planet closest to the Sun with almost no atmosphere and extreme surface temperature variations.

earth.name: Earth (3rd Terrestrial Planet)
earth.description: Third terrestrial planet from the Sun located in the habitable zone, sustaining liquid surface water, an oxygen-rich atmosphere, and life.

venus.name: Venus (2nd Rocky Planet)
venus.description: Second terrestrial planet from the Sun with a dense carbon dioxide atmosphere that traps heat via a runaway greenhouse effect.

mars.name: Mars (4th Rocky Planet)
mars.description: Fourth terrestrial planet from the Sun with an iron-oxide-rich dusty surface, polar ice caps, and a thin carbon dioxide atmosphere.

asteroid_belt.name: Asteroid Belt
asteroid_belt.description: Circumstellar disc of irregular rocky and metallic bodies orbiting between the inner terrestrial planet Mars and the outer gas giant Jupiter.

jupiter.name: Jupiter (Largest Gas Giant)
jupiter.description: Fifth planet from the Sun and largest gas giant in the Solar System, composed primarily of hydrogen and helium with prominent banded cloud belts.

uranus.name: Uranus (7th Ice Giant)
uranus.description: Seventh planet from the Sun; an ice giant whose methane-rich upper atmosphere gives it a pale cyan colour and whose axis of rotation is tilted sideways.

neptune.name: Neptune (8th Outermost Ice Giant)
neptune.description: Eighth and furthest known planet from the Sun; a cold, deep-blue ice giant with supersonic atmospheric winds.

saturn.name: Saturn (Ringed Gas Giant)
saturn.description: Sixth planet from the Sun; a large gas giant distinguished by its extensive, bright concentric ring system made of ice and rock particles.
